steps.hint: Click a survivor to select, then left-click near the fire to walk there (double-click to run).
Click the Fighter, then left-click the zombie to attack it with the knife.
steps.retry: Use the knife: click the Fighter, then left-click the new zombie.

steps.hint: Click the Scout, press {weapon1} for the Gun, then left-click the zombie. Every shot uses one of the rounds.
steps.retry: Shoot it: click the Scout, press {weapon1} for the Gun, then left-click the new zombie.

steps.hint: Click a survivor, press {hold}, then click toward the woods where it comes from. A survivor on Hold strikes whatever walks up to them inside the green cone.
steps.retry: Hold the line: click a survivor, press {hold}, then click toward the new zombie.
